header.title: How to Install a Double Pole Circuit Breaker
header.description: This guide provides instructions on how to safely install a double pole circuit breaker. It covers determining the correct breaker size, wire gauge, and cable type for the installation.

steps.description: Determine the appropriate size circuit breaker by checking the appliance's nameplate for amperage requirements.
actions: Find the amperage the appliance will draw

steps.description: This step advises consulting an electrician to determine the appropriate wire gauge and cable configuration based on the appliance's power rating.
actions: Determine the size of the cable
Figure out whether it needs a Neutral wire

steps.description: This step explains the proper cable usage for 240-volt circuits, differentiating between standard and appliances requiring both 240V and 120V.
actions: Use the proper cable with at least two colored wires (one black and one other color besides white—usually red).
Connect the white wire to the Neutral bus.
Connect two colored wires to the two circuit breaker terminals inside the panel.
Connect the white Neutral wire to the Neutral bus (Figure 7).
Connect the two colored wires to the two circuit breaker terminals inside the panel.
Ground the GND wires (bare and green wires) to GND terminals (Figure 7) and appliances’ chassis.
